gaps.explanation: Re-trim pass 5. New pages 17-24 (nonmajor governmental summary p17-18, special revenue combining p19-24), 40 (Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax nonmajor debt service fund), 43-48 (nonmajor capital project funds combining), 49 (permanent funds), 50-51 (nonmajor enterprise combining). Added one line per printed non-zero row per individual fund column for funds with no detail lines yet: special revenue Public Library Contribution (p19) and Miscellaneous Contributions (p20); all capital project funds (p43-48); permanent funds Western Heritage and Endowment for Library (p49). Revenue added 16,115,345 = Public Library Contribution 841,706 + Miscellaneous Contributions 2,641,780 + capital project funds 12,495,289 (= printed Total Capital Projects revenues p48) + permanent funds 136,570 (= printed Total Permanent Funds p49). Airport Business Park Development (p44) and 2022 Parks and Recreation Bond (p47) print no revenue/expenditure. Funds SKIPPED because they already have detail lines (budgetary comparison schedules / earlier fixes): Judgment, Library Fines and Fees (detail 'Library Fine and Fees Fund'), Douglas County Library Supplement, Keno/Lottery Proceeds, Storm Water Fee Revenue, City Street Maintenance, Interceptor Sewer Construction, Community Park Development, State Turn Back Revenue, Ballpark Revenue, Keno Lottery Reserve (detail 'Keno/Lottery Reserve Fund'), Greater Omaha Convention and Visitors Center (detail 'Greater Omaha Convention and Visitors Bureau Fund'), Destination Marketing Corporation, Household Chemical Disposal, Development Revenue (p19-24), and Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax (p40). Nonmajor enterprise funds (p50-51: Tranquility Park, City Wide Sports Revenue, Marinas, Tennis Operations, Golf Operations, Air Quality, Printing Services and Graphics, Riverfront Plaza and Marina) are NOT added: detail already holds the combined 'Nonmajor Enterprise Funds' column from the proprietary funds statement p9 (charges 8,834,109, expenses, interest 7,376, transfers in 138,985), which equals the printed Total Nonmajor Enterprise column p51. Tie with the statement not required (user rule 2026-11-17).
